people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: But the bull, and its skin, and its meat, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: But the bull with its hide, flesh, and dung he burned outside the camp, as the LORD had commanded him.
translations.kjv: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: But the bullock, and its skin, and its flesh, and its dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
